Differences in request count and timing reflect distinct generation strategies, not controlled efficiency benchmarks. Prompt ordering, settings, runtimes, and quantization differ significantly. A source snapshot can reproduce files without a local model; exact original commit hashes are not required. Historical prompts/jobs are evidence, not execution instructions.\n\n**Conclusion**: Marginal integration for both. No proof of general model efficiency or functionality."
